title: AI Engineer
job_description:
Candidate Profile Fresh graduate or 1–2 years working experience Hands-on builder (not theory-focused) Has explored AI tools beyond basic usage Able to convert ideas into working prototypes Curious, proactive, and willing to learn fast Essential Diploma / Degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent self-taught experience) Basic programming skills ( Python preferred ) Understanding of APIs and system integration Strong problem-solving mindset Ability to adapt to evolving technologies and project requirements Mandatory (Key Filter) Must have built at least ONE AI-related project , such as: Chatbot using LLM API (e.g., OpenAI or similar) AI-assisted automation script Simple AI application (e.g., document Q&A, prompt-based tool)

Develop automation scripts, internal tools, and simple applications Integrate systems via APIs and data workflows Support development of AI-powered features (chatbots, assistants, automation tools) Work with structured and unstructured data Assist in deployment, testing, and debugging Continuously explore and apply modern AI tools and technologies

Work on real AI-driven projects, not just theory Gain exposure to automation, APIs, and modern AI tools Opportunity to grow into AI Engineer / Full-Stack Developer roles Fast-paced, learning-focused environment

Machine Learning Deep Learning Python Data Science Artificial Intelligence
